files.model.yaml:
objects:
  ui:
    type: system
    name: UI
  screen:
    type: app
    in: ui
    name: Screen
  banner:
    type: app
    in: ui
    name: Banner
  management:
    type: system
    name: Management
  agent:
    type: app
    in: management
    name: Agent
  linux:
    type: system
    name: Linux
  cloud:
    type: system
    name: Cloud
  bus:
    type: system
    name: Bus
connections:
  - from: ui
    to: management
    label: Request and reply
    kind: request
  - from: ui
    to: management
    label: Start scan
    kind: stream
    payloads:
      - scan-request
  - from: management
    to: ui
    label: Scan results
    kind: publish
  - from: management
    to: ui
    label: Radio state
    kind: cached
  - from: screen
    to: agent
    label: Ask
  - from: banner
    to: agent
    label: Banner
  - from: management
    to: cloud
    label: Fetch update
    kind: request
  - from: management
    to: bus
    label: Events
    kind: publish
  - from: agent
    to: linux
    label: Apply config
    kind: request
  - from: management
    to: linux
    label: Apply config
    kind: request
  - from: linux
    to: management
files.flows/rides.yaml:
name: Rides
view: root
steps:
  - from: ui
    to: management
    text: The screen starts a scan
    via: " start SCAN "
  - from: ui
    to: management
    text: The screen sends its request
    payload: scan-request
  - from: banner
    to: agent
    text: The banner asks the agent
  - from: ui
    to: agent
    text: Nothing says which line
  - from: ui
    to: management
    text: The screen names a line that is not there
    via: Nope
  - from: management
    to: ui
    text: Results reach the screen
  - from: management
    to: ui
    text: The first results come back
    via: Start scan
  - from: cloud
    to: management
    text: The update comes back
  - from: bus
    to: management
    text: Nothing returns on a publish
  - from: management
    to: linux
    text: The config is applied
